name: curved-walls-simple
description: Simple ladder for curved/arc walls (curvedWalls, SweetHome3DJS parity). Verifies the flag is OFF in Simple / ON in Pro; opens the 2D editor, selects a wall, confirms its bulge handle renders, drives a real synthetic drag on the handle, and asserts the wall gained an `arc` (it bowed into a curve).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: curvedWalls should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: curvedWalls should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: select-a-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const w = s.floorPlan.walls[0]; window.__wallId = w.id; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'wall', id: w.id }); })()

steps.name: bulge-handle-visible
steps.failMessage: wall bulge handle did not render on the selected wall in Pro mode

steps.name: drag-bulge
steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const el = document.querySelector('[data-wall-bulge="'+window.__wallId+'"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('bulge handle not found'); const svg = el.closest('svg'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width/2, cy = r.top + r.height/2; const mk = (type, x, y) => new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0 }); el.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', cx, cy)); await sleep(80); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', cx + 40, cy + 40)); await sleep(80); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', cx + 40, cy + 40)); })()

steps.name: verify-wall-curved

waitFor.store: (() => { const w = state.floorPlan.walls.find(w => w.id === window.__wallId); return !!w && typeof w.arc === 'number' && Math.abs(w.arc) > 0.05; })()

steps.failMessage: dragging the bulge handle did not give the wall an arc
